description: This file defines an interface for a Dictionary component within the WPEFramework project. It includes nested interfaces for notifications and iteration over dictionary entries, along with methods for registering, unregistering, getting, and setting key-value pairs in a namespaced dictionary.

classes.name: IDictionary
classes.description: An interface providing access to dictionary operations such as register, unregister, get, and set key-value pairs within a namespace.

classes.name: IDictionary::INotification
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications when a dictionary value changes.

classes.name: IDictionary::IIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating over dictionary entries within a namespace.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for changes within a specific namespace.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification sink.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key within a namespace.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the value for a key within a namespace.

methods.name: Get (IIterator)
methods.description: Returns an iterator for iterating over entries in a namespace.

ctags.name: IDictionary
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL IDictionary : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/

ctags.name: IIterator
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL IIterator : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/

ctags.name: INotification
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL INotification : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
